name: Liam Gallagher
title: Liam Gallagher Face Mask – Fancy Dress Cardboard Costume Mask
body:

Liam Gallagher Card Face Mask for Parties

Each Liam Gallagher face mask is digitally printed in full colour on 350gsm silk card. We also make custom masks from your own photo.
